w:r.w:t: Business Rules Expenses and Benefits 2025/26 P11D and P11D(b)
These Business Rules apply to live filing submissions from 06/04/2026
This document is intended to illustrate the structure, format and validation requirements necessary for the electronic filing of Expenses and Benefits forms.
The business requirements of HMRC and the demands of back-end systems drive the validation requirements.
Within this document is a listing of all data items required for the electronic equivalent of the form P11D and P11D(b).
